about_p1: I’m almost reluctant to write this review, as I consider Tom a best kept secret. He’s professional, thorough, experienced and HONEST! He’s also BMW Factory Certified. He’s done extensive work on my e36 M3, e85 Z4 and MB a45 AMG. I’m very pleased with High Rock Autoworks and Tom will continue to be first call for me.
about_p2: I meet with Tom, to check my car out first and he spent over an hour inspecting and going over the services (some not listed)I inquired about. He was very thorough, professional, and personable. I knew than that I wanted someone with these qualities working on my car. Best decision I made, he did an awesome job on my car l would definitely recommend Tom. Price was very reasonable! Thanks Tom….
